      "code": "\n# Sample size for proportion estimation with specified precision\n# Using normal approximation with exact z-critical value\n\n# Parameters\np <- 0.70                          # target proportion\nE <- 0.03                          # half-width (margin of error)\nalpha <- 0.05                      # significance level (two-sided)\nconf_level <- 0.95                 # confidence level\n\n# Exact standard normal 97.5th percentile (two-sided 95% CI)\nz_critical <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)\n\ncat(\"Design Parameters:\\n\")\ncat(\"Target proportion (p):\", p, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Confidence level:\", conf_level, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Half-width (margin of error, E):\", E, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Significance level (alpha):\", alpha, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Exact z-critical (97.5th percentile):\", z_critical, \"\\n\\n\")\n\n# Formula: n = z^2 * p(1-p) / E^2\nn_continuous <- (z_critical^2 * p * (1 - p)) / (E^2)\n\ncat(\"Continuous solution:\\n\")\ncat(\"n = z^2 * p(1-p) / E^2\\n\")\ncat(\"n = \", z_critical^2, \" * \", p*(1-p), \" / \", E^2, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"n = \", n_continuous, \"\\n\\n\")\n\n# Round upward\nn_rounded <- ceiling(n_continuous)\n\ncat(\"Sample size (rounded upward):\", n_rounded, \"\\n\\n\")\n\n# Verification: check achieved half-width at rounded sample size\nachieved_se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_rounded)\nachieved_half_width <- z_critical * achieved_se\n\ncat(\"Verification at n =\", n_rounded, \":\\n\")\ncat(\"Standard error:\", achieved_se, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Achieved half-width (margin of error):\", achieved_half_width, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Target half-width:\", E, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Requirement met:\", achieved_half_width <= E, \"\\n\\n\")\n\n# Output as JSON\nresults <- list(\n  metric = \"sample_size\",\n  value = n_rounded,\n  unit = \"participants_total\"\n)\n\ncat(\"POWER_AGENT_RESULT=\")\ncat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(results)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))\n",
